criteria.description: [R1] `from app_int.main import round_currency` succeeds and `round_currency` is callable.
[R2, R3] round_currency(2.345) returns a value numerically equal to 2.35 (not 2.34).
[R3] round_currency(2.355) returns a value numerically equal to 2.36, and round_currency(0.005) returns a value numerically equal to 0.01.
[R3, R7] round_currency(1.005) returns a value numerically equal to 1.01 (the binary-float representation of 1.005 must not cause it to round down to 1.00).
[R4] round_currency(-2.345) returns a value numerically equal to -2.35, and round_currency(-0.005) returns a value numerically equal to -0.01.
[R5] round_currency(2.344) equals 2.34, round_currency(2.346) equals 2.35, and round_currency(-2.344) equals -2.34.
[R6] round_currency(2.34) equals 2.34, round_currency(5) equals 5.00, and round_currency(0) equals 0.00.
[R2, R8] For every input in AC-2 to AC-7, the return value is a number (not a str), and str() of the return value shows at most 2 digits after the decimal point.
[R9] health_check() still returns {"status": "ok"} and add(2, 3) still returns 5; the existing tests in tests/test_main.py pass without modification.
[R10] The round_currency docstring explicitly states that it rounds to 2 decimal places using round-half-up (exact halves away from zero).
[R11] `uv run ruff check .` exits with status 0.

[R12] The tests directory contains at least one test of round_currency for each of: a positive exact half, a negative exact half, a non-half value, and a value that already has 2 or fewer decimal places.
